rows.note: Use this attributive construction for a file or document included with an email or other message.

example.english: Please check the file attached to this email.
example.traditional: 呢封電郵隨附嘅檔案請查收。
example.jyutping: ni1 fung1 din6 jau4 ceoi4 fu6 ge3 dong2 on3 cing2 caa4 sau1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for things that are physically connected or joined.

example.english: The two buildings are attached by a footbridge.
example.jyutping: loeng5 zo6 daai6 haa6 jau4 tin1 kiu4 soeng1 lin4

rows.note: Use this construction when someone has developed affection or an emotional bond with A.

example.english: After dating Ming for so long, she is attached to him.
example.traditional: 佢同阿明拍拖咁耐，早就對阿明有感情喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tung4 aa3 ming4 paak3 to1 gam3 noi6 zou2 zau6 deoi3 aa3 ming4 jau5 gam2 cing4 laa3

rows.note: Use 有伴 when saying someone is romantically taken rather than available for dating.

example.english: They are already attached, so don’t ask them out again.
example.traditional: 佢已經有伴，唔好再約佢喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 ging1 jau5 bun6 m4 hou2 zoi3 joek3 keoi5 laa3
